note: Bank Asia's credit card fees and charges (July 2026): its Silver / Classic card's annual fee is 1,500 taka, 1,725 with the 15% VAT the schedule applies to all fees, and its interest rate is 25% a year.

sources.title: Bank Asia, Credit Card Fees and Charges (14 July 2026)
